question: Which political party has won the bye elections to the constituency of Ludhiana west held in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aam Aadmi Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party** (**AAP**) emerged victorious in the **Ludhiana West** constituency during the bye-elections held in **June 2025**.
 
• The bye-election was conducted to fill a vacancy in the **Punjab Legislative Assembly**, which consists of **117** seats in total.
 
• This victory solidified the **Aam Aadmi Party**'s position in the state of **Punjab**, where it had previously won a massive mandate in the **2022 Assembly Elections**. ***Hence, the statement regarding AAP's win is correct.***
 
• The **Ludhiana West** seat is considered a crucial urban constituency, reflecting the political sentiment of the industrial hub of **Ludhiana**.
 
• The election was managed by the Election Commission of I
